scope: Read-only adversarial review of recovered.py, models.py, source_events.py, source_information.py, and tests/test_recovered_runtime.py against preserved M0/M1 and OL/EX sources. No original producer imported or run, no data replay, workers, fitting, migration, AWS or trading.
cross_model: Skipped: delegated non-interactive review; no external CLI invoked.

findings.issue: Derives source flow-window end from recognition timestamp instead of preserving the explicit source last_closed_second.
findings.evidence: research_atlas_stack.py lines 61-69 and M0M1_BINDING_RECOVERY.json/input_contract.clock use end=c[last_closed_second], requiring only (end+1)*NS <= recognition. A recognition at 22s with source end=20 and complete bins 1..20 is valid under that source contract but the helper rejects it because it demands bins 2..21. Replacing with newer bins would change model inputs.
findings.recommendation: Require explicit last_closed_second from the causal recognition event and verify closure <= recognition; do not silently substitute a newer window.

findings.issue: Coordinate validator accepts sparse, duplicate or reordered prior book rows.
findings.evidence: signal=[10,10,100,1000], prior=[[6,6,60,600],[8,8,80,800],[9,9,90,900]] returns True; reordered [[9,9,90,900],[7,7,70,700],[8,8,80,800]] also returns True. OL_history requires exactly the three immediately preceding book closes in chronological order.
findings.recommendation: Require exactly three prior rows with book indices and group ordinals signal-3, signal-2, signal-1, preserving strict cursor order and causal clocks.

findings.issue: Hash checks authenticate preserved source files but do not bind recovery metadata to those authenticated files or fixed feature semantics.
findings.evidence: M0M1_BINDING_RECOVERY.json is not in SOURCE_MANIFEST.json. Its feature definitions and producer/operator file/hash metadata are unused by verification; only feature id-to-name pairing is checked. In-memory mutation of a definition and producer.git_blob_sha to an incorrect value passes the current predicate. This is a provenance-verification gap, not evidence that current coefficients or formulas are wrong.
findings.recommendation: Validate every referenced source against the authenticated manifest and bind recovered IDs/semantics to a fixed verified runtime definition registry or pinned recovery digest. Alternatively narrow the verifier claim to source-file integrity and model-state/name ordering.

findings.issue: Empty retained quote history crashes rather than preserving missing endpoint state.
findings.evidence: endpoint([],100) raises IndexError at times[-1]. OL/EX missing contract says missing endpoints remain unavailable; other unavailable boundaries here return None.
findings.recommendation: Return None before indexing an empty sequence and add an empty-history synthetic boundary check.

verification.result: 11 tests passed, including newly added group-contiguity and integer-price checks.
